title: PPG-MS31 — Shop Pilot + Training Budget + Bottleneck-First Sequencing
description: Closes the shop-floor-readiness gap surfaced by R12 scrutiny (score 58). Adds MS-PILOT-0 (1 machine + 2-week soak), operator-training-hours field per envelope, shadow-mode week before cutover, DNC/Fusion-down fallback, MS4 reorder to bottleneck-first.
rationale: Closes the shop-floor-readiness gap surfaced by R12 scrutiny (score 58). Adds MS-PILOT-0 (1 machine + 2-week soak), operator-training-hours field per envelope, shadow-mode week before cutover, DNC/Fusion-down fallback, MS4 reorder to bottleneck-first.

units.title: MS-PILOT-0: 1 machine (Mitsubishi MV1200R) + 1 op + 2-week soak
units.scope: Single-machine pilot before fleet rollout. Bottleneck-first (MV1200R is highest-margin). Daily standup + weekly retro. Soak success criteria gate fleet rollout.

units.title: operator_training_hours field added to every envelope + cross-roll-up budget
units.scope: Each PPG-MS gets operator_training_hours field; sum across all machines + operators. JM Die: 8 ops × 2 shifts × 21 machines × half-day per machine = 168 person-hours model. Roadmap dashboard shows training hours alongside dev hours.

units.title: Shadow-mode week before MS12 cutover
units.scope: PRISM emits + recommends; operator runs legacy program. Compare cycle times + scrap. Operator trust-formation gate before cutover.

units.title: DNC + Fusion-down fallback procedure
units.scope: When PRISM is unavailable: legacy DNC fallback documented + tested; Fusion-down → MS17 degrades gracefully (Tier A only); shop runs as if PRISM not installed. No production stoppage.

units.title: MS4 fleet reorder: bottleneck-first by $/hr saved
units.scope: Reorder fleet rollout: MV1200R (highest-margin) → Hurco V11 → Okuma B250 → Multus → support machines. Each machine has $/hr-saved estimate. Skip support machines until $/hr threshold reached.

completion_criteria: MS-PILOT-0 (MV1200R + 2 weeks) shows ≥10% cycle-time win + zero rollback
